I told Ilse in our DM that it's Bay 30, as she said on Oct 14.

I got the answer from her own DM history with me, not the brain. The brain refused to look up her saved note because its connection isn't linked to any member, so it won't read on someone's behalf. That means the private notes I save there can't be read back until someone fixes the access setup on the brain host. Its suggested fix is to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'`, or `--may-act-for <members>` since I act for several people.
